journey.name: Memory Leak Check - Feed Surface
journey.description:
Verifies that switching top-level feed tabs (Following, Discover, Pinned Feeds) and opening Manage Feeds does not retain FeedViewModel or tab state upon pop/recreation.
Executes 3 loop iterations with theme switches (dark/light) to trigger Activity recreation while observing LeakCanary output.

actions.action: Verify that the app is open on the Home feed
Tap the Discover tab or swipe to Discover feed
Verify that Discover feed content is visible
Tap the Lists button next to the Discover tab
Verify that the Pinned lists sheet is visible
Tap the first list in the Pinned lists sheet
Verify that the list feed content is visible
Verify that the Manage Feeds screen is visible
Press the system back button to return to feed
Verify that Home feed is visible
Verify that Following feed is visible
Switch the device to dark theme
Switch the device back to light theme
Repeat all of the steps above two more times
Press the Home button to send the app to the background, then wait 15 seconds for LeakCanary analysis
Verify that no LeakCanary leak notification appears except for known accessibility delegate semantics cache
